name: claude-sbx-status
description: Status bar badge showing whether the Claude Code extension runs inside a Docker Sandbox (sbx).

commands.title: Claude sbx: Create Sandbox for This Folder

claudeSbx.sandboxName.description: Use this sandbox for every folder. Leave empty to use CLAUDE_SBX_NAME, or else the sandbox whose workspace contains the open folder (same as the wrapper).

claudeSbx.offerCreate.description: When the sandbox wrapper is on and no sandbox mounts the open folder, offer to create one (sbx create claude <folder>).

claudeSbx.sbxPath.description: Full path to the sbx CLI. Leave empty to use CLAUDE_SBX_BIN, the wrapper's default, or common install locations.

claudeSbx.wrapperPath.description: Wrapper to set as claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper when turning the sandbox on.

claudeSbx.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often to check the sandbox status.

claudeSbx.showWhenLocal.description: Show a 'Claude: local' badge when the sandbox wrapper isn't in use.
